title: Group admin promotion/demotion endpoint absent (spec 18.8.2 Admin Delegation)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.8.2: Only owner can promote/demote admins (POST /groups/{gid}/admins with action promote/demote). Classification: not-implemented. Evidence: no /admins resource in any stack (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py has no admins route; admins arise only via admin-role invitations at join_key groups_collection.py:788-791; rust/lichen-gateway/src/membership.rs has role types but no endpoint; C none). Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_collection.py + python/src/lichen/group_membership.py role authority; then Rust/C parity. Refs R-12-061.
